name: Raleigh County Emergency Services Authority
emergencyText: IF THIS IS AN EMERGENCY, DIAL 911 immediately.
metaDescription: Official website of the Raleigh County Emergency Services Authority: 911 dispatch, addressing and street signs, alarm monitoring, and emergency management for Beckley and Raleigh County, WV.
footerEmergencyText: From any phone, any time. Stay on the line and follow the telecommunicator’s instructions.
